verdict.rationale: Suggesting or automatically applying fixes for findings is a fair question for a security scanner, so the axis applies. The evidence shows TruffleHog detecting, verifying and analyzing secrets, blocking commits via hooks, tracking whether remediation has occurred, and sending alerts asking developers to rotate keys. None of this is a suggested or automatic code fix, so these adjacent capabilities earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply suggested or automatic code fixes for findings instead of only reading reports
